description:
## Decide 1.0 scope

Single biggest call for the 1.0 release. All other roadmap children cascade from this.

## Options

### (A) Narrow scope (Recommended)

11 crates ship at 1.0:

- pkix-path
- pkix-revocation
- pkix-chain
- pkix-path-builder
- pkix-truststore
- pkix-identity
- pkix-profiles
- pkix-profiles-cabf
- pkix-lint
- pkix-lint-cabf
- pkix-revocation-http

All adjacent and skeleton crates (pkix-aia, pkix-aia-http, pkix-policy-zlint, pkix-policy-pkilint, pkix-zlint-bridge, pkix-pkilint-bridge, pkix-ac, pkix-ct, pkix-composite, pkix-dane, pkix-dane-resolver, pkix-truststore-system, pkix-truststore-pkcs11) stay at 0.x and ship independently post-1.0.

**Rationale:**
- Matches AGENTS.md driving goal verbatim ("RFC 5280 X.509 for Rust, done right from the start")
- 1.0 promise is "you can verify X.509 cert chains for TLS / S/MIME / code signing / time-stamping / OCSP" — which works today with current shipped code
- Adjacent ecosystem is genuinely additive, not part of the core promise
- Shortest path to a real release

**Behavior change:** chains needing AIA-fetched intermediates fail validation with `Error::AiaChainBuildFailed` — caller must provide full chain. This is the current behavior; 1.0 documents it as intentional. AiaFetcher ships in pkix-aia-0.x post-1.0.

### (B) Wide scope

Adds the adjacent ecosystem to 1.0:

- pkix-aia + pkix-aia-http (AIA online fetching; PKIX-zkjb cascade)
- pkix-policy-zlint + pkix-pkilint + bridges (PKIX-jy95.7/.8/.10/.11 cascade)

17 crates total. Requires the AiaFetcher cascade + adapter crates to land before publishing.

**Rationale:** "complete PKIX experience" at 1.0. Callers don't need to discover and assemble adjacent crates separately.

**Cost:** 2-3 weeks of cascade work before publish-ready.

### (C) Very wide scope

Adds DANE and fully-implemented AC/CT to 1.0:

- pkix-dane + pkix-dane-resolver (PKIX-j32w cascade)
- pkix-ac with all 4 children implemented (PKIX-ng0x cascade)
- pkix-ct (would need design + implementation; currently skeleton)

22+ crates total. 2-3 months.

**Rationale:** comprehensive PKIX-related coverage in one release.

**Cost:** months. Risks scope creep; some of these (DANE, CT) might benefit from being shaped by community feedback after their own 0.x release.

## Recommendation

**(A) narrow.** Cleanest 1.0 promise. Adjacent crates have their own value and roadmap; bundling them into 1.0 conflates "RFC 5280 done right" with "complete PKIX ecosystem," which isn't the same thing.

## Cascade after this decision

- .2 skeleton/stub disposition is implicit under (A): all hold at 0.x (or stay deferred)
- .3 API stability pass scopes to the 11 crates
- .6 Limitations audit scopes to the 11 crates
- .7 CHANGELOG roll-up scopes to the 11 crates

Under (B)/(C), .2 expands into per-crate ship-at-1.0 sub-decisions.

## Out of scope

- Implementation work on any 1.0-included crate (its own beads)
- Post-1.0 roadmap for adjacent ecosystem (separate planning surface)

## Cross-references

- PKIX-wlsr (parent)
- AGENTS.md driving goal
notes:
[2026-05-13 narrow scope amendment from Verifier decision]

Mark's PKIX-wlsr.3 decision (Verifier 3-generic with NoAiaFetcher default) requires AiaFetcher trait + NoAiaFetcher + AiaError to exist in pkix-aia core crate at 1.0 publish. pkix-aia is added to narrow scope: **12 crates**, not 11. pkix-aia-http stays post-1.0.

Amended narrow scope:

1. pkix-path
2. pkix-revocation
3. pkix-chain (now 3-generic Verifier)
4. pkix-path-builder
5. pkix-truststore
6. pkix-identity
7. pkix-profiles
8. pkix-profiles-cabf
9. pkix-lint
10. pkix-lint-cabf
11. pkix-revocation-http
12. **pkix-aia** (NEW; trait + NoAiaFetcher + AiaError only; no fetching behavior)
[2026-05-13 RESOLVED: narrow scope]

**Decision: (A) narrow — 12 crates.**

Original narrow scope was 11 crates; amended to 12 by the Verifier 3-generic decision in PKIX-wlsr.3 which requires pkix-aia (trait + NoAiaFetcher + AiaError) at 1.0 publish.

Final 1.0 crate list:

1. pkix-path
2. pkix-revocation
3. pkix-chain (3-generic Verifier)
4. pkix-path-builder
5. pkix-truststore
6. pkix-identity
7. pkix-profiles
8. pkix-profiles-cabf
9. pkix-lint
10. pkix-lint-cabf
11. pkix-revocation-http
12. pkix-aia (trait + NoAiaFetcher + AiaError only)

Rejected:
- (B) wide: scope creep; adjacent ecosystem (pkix-aia-http, pkix-policy-zlint, pkix-policy-pkilint, bridges) genuinely belongs at 0.x sibling cadence
- (C) very wide: months of work; DANE / fully-implemented AC / CT all benefit from 0.x iteration before 1.0 lock-in

Rationale: matches AGENTS.md driving goal verbatim ('RFC 5280 X.509 for Rust, done right from the start'). Anything beyond this list is scope creep dressed up as completeness.
title: Decide 1.0 scope: narrow (~11 crates) / wide (~17) / very wide (~22+)
